title: Introduction to geno2ped
text: geno2ped R package rapid pedigree construction SNP genotype data. infers parent-offspring relationships using genomic similarity Mendelian error validation, supports PLINK, VCF, CSV input formats.

title: Introduction to geno2ped
code: devtools::install_github("ampofoissabel-quangen/geno2ped")

title: Introduction to geno2ped
code: library(geno2ped) #> Warning: replacing previous import 'S4Arrays::makeNindexFromArrayViewport' by #> 'DelayedArray::makeNindexFromArrayViewport' when loading 'SummarizedExperiment'

title: Introduction to geno2ped
text: simplest input format CSV first column contains sample IDs remaining columns contain SNP genotypes (0/1/2):
code: geno <- read_genotypes(   csv             = "path/to/genotypes.csv",   sample_metadata = "path/to/metadata.csv" )

title: Introduction to geno2ped
code: geno <- read_genotypes(   bed_prefix      = "path/to/mydata",   sample_metadata = "path/to/metadata.csv" )

title: Introduction to geno2ped
code: geno <- read_genotypes(   vcf             = "path/to/mydata.vcf.gz",   sample_metadata = "path/to/metadata.csv" )

title: Introduction to geno2ped
text: easiest way use built-preset: Three presets available:
code: res <- build_pedigree(   geno,   preset  = "high_precision",   verbose = TRUE )

title: Introduction to geno2ped
code: res <- build_pedigree(   geno,   s_threshold    = 0.75,   me_max         = 0.003,   oh_max         = 20,   use_sex        = TRUE,   use_age        = TRUE,   min_parent_gap = 2,   top_k          = 3 )

title: Introduction to geno2ped
code: # View the pedigree res$pedigree  # View summary statistics res$summary

title: Introduction to geno2ped
code: # Similarity score distribution plot_kinship(res)  # Mendelian error rate distribution plot_me(res)  # Assignment outcome counts plot_assignment_status(res)

title: Introduction to geno2ped
text: creates following files geno2ped_results/: my_run_pedigree.csv — final pedigree my_run_assignments.csv — candidate scores my_run_trios.csv — best trios my_run_summary.txt — run statistics my_run_settings.txt — parameters used
code: write_outputs(   res,   outdir = "geno2ped_results",   prefix = "my_run" )

title: Rapid Pedigree Construction from SNP Genotypes
text: geno2ped R package rapid pedigree construction SNP genotype data. supports PLINK (bed/bim/fam) VCF/VCF.GZ input formats infers familial relationships genomic similarity.

title: Rapid Pedigree Construction from SNP Genotypes
code: # install.packages("devtools") devtools::install_github("ampofoissabel-quangen/geno2ped")

title: Rapid Pedigree Construction from SNP Genotypes
code: # For PLINK files install.packages("bigsnpr")  # For VCF files install.packages("BiocManager") BiocManager::install("VariantAnnotation")

title: Rapid Pedigree Construction from SNP Genotypes
code: library(geno2ped)  data <- read_genotypes(   bed_prefix = "path/to/mydata",        # points to mydata.bed/.bim/.fam   sample_metadata = "path/to/meta.csv"  # optional: columns ID, Sex, BirthYear )  # Access results data$G    # genotype matrix (samples x SNPs), values 0/1/2 data$ids  # sample IDs data$map  # SNP map (chr, pos, snp) data$meta # sample metadata

title: Rapid Pedigree Construction from SNP Genotypes
code: data <- read_genotypes(   vcf = "path/to/mydata.vcf.gz",   sample_metadata = "path/to/meta.csv" )

Rapid Pedigree Construction from SNP Genotypes
text: read_genotypes() returns list : - $G — numeric matrix genotypes (0/1/2), rows = samples, cols = SNPs - $ids — character vector sample IDs - $map — data.frame columns chr, pos, snp - $meta — data.frame sample metadata (NULL provided)

title: Build a pedigree from SNP genotypes with tunable thresholds — build_pedigree
text: geno List read_genotypes() containing G, ids, map, meta. s_threshold Minimum pairwise similarity candidate parent-offspring. me_max Maximum Mendelian error rate accept trio. oh_max Maximum opposing homozygotes per candidate. use_sex TRUE, restrict sires Sex == "M" dams Sex == "F". use_age TRUE, require parents older offspring. min_parent_gap Minimum years older offspring. top_k Keep top-k candidates per offspring per role trio check. preset One "none", "high_precision", "high_coverage". verbose Print progress.
